author: Tazz
body:
(p.s. Dualzz sent this to me on Skype, I'm just posting it for him.)

Hello
I am very sorry for my actions, I would never do this again. However, it was not real pornography, it was pictures on my texture pack and someone asked for a picture. I would like to be unbanned because this server is very fun and I would like to play on it. I have not ban evaded at all and I believe I have waited long enough for my actions to be forgiven. Yet again, I apologise for my actions; it was very immature but I believe I should be given a second chance.
Thanks
Dualzz
